**Coaching Note:**
Your queen on b7 was perfectly placed to attack the exposed king. When your opponent moved the king, you had a discovered attack—notice how the queen can fork the king and multiple pieces (the d4 pawn, h7 pawn, and a8 rook). Always look for moves that attack the king *and* something else; the king's reply might leave another piece hanging.
